label: Strict-ground map for nonmutual existential dependence: content, sense and rivals
summary: Repair after the PR #1600 semantic challenge. (1) The map's Lean type is a structural surrogate: S and the labelling are arbitrary and PLG atoms are uninterpreted, so the type encodes only that distinct-step D embeds into the strict order of a consistent PLG theory. Reading the labels as existence facts and the edges as faithful grounding is an OPEN interpretation outside the type. (2) Verified strength: consistency plus the map force distinct-step D to have no finite cycle (mapForcesDistinctDependenceAcyclic), which is strictly more than nonmutuality. So the map's warrant is a warrant for acyclicity. Well-foundedness for finite Atom and the converse embedding are not verified or relied on. (3) Sense: disambiguation 23dd6f32 gives D sense 1 (DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING, efficient-causal) and 'ground' sense 2 (formal uninterpreted strict partial ground), bridged only by the OPEN map. The constitutive/metaphysical reading of the atoms does not cover D's own paradigm edge (sun/light), so it would need a restricted non-causal receives-esse relation. On the natural/causal reading the warrant reduces to efficient-causal asymmetry strengthened to acyclicity. (4) Rivals to the map: modal co-existence; symmetric metaphysical dependence (Barnes 2018, Thompson 2016; challenger-cited, attribution deferred); vacuous counterpossibles. On the last, any two distinct necessary beings mutually D-depend, so the map plus consistency allows at most one necessary being in B. The map therefore depends on a non-vacuist semantics for D or a domain restriction, which DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING leaves unspecified. (5) Nonvacuity: a joint Nat model with a nonempty D is verified. No substantive objection to the formal validity was identified.
blocker: The map's interpretation is unresolved. Next tests: (a) type a restricted non-causal receives-esse relation with its own definition and Lean declaration, and test the map on it; (b) type a causal ordering of existence facts and compare its warrant with STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-NOT-DEPENDENT-ON-EFFECT; (c) fix whether D's counterpossibles are vacuist or non-vacuist (related to #1593); (d) assess the Barnes/Thompson symmetric-dependence cases after reading the texts.
